execution_domain.memories: all CompCert mem including invalid, uninitialized, unwritable states

target.nan_policy: CompCert Floats and target Archi definitions; hashes bind exact policy
target.trust_boundary: CompCert C semantics; no automatic GCC binary or hardware equivalence

obligations.coverage: The actual entry is the unchanged Internal function call for every list val and every memory; the syntax invariant is automatic.
At every reachable original state, exact bidirectional raw successor equivalence preserves every float operation, value, NaN/error behavior and trace.
At every reachable original state, exact bidirectional raw successor equivalence preserves all machine-integer, shift, cast and pointer operations.
At every reachable original state, exact raw successor equivalence preserves loads, stores, allocation, free, invalid access and unknown-byte behavior.
Unbounded bidirectional star equivalence from arbitrary entry arguments and memory; no fuel limit or selected order.
Every returned value and memory has equivalent raw source/model executions, and byte observations are literally the same Mem.loadbytes.
At every reachable original state, source non-normal-return/nostep is equivalent to model non-normal-return/nostep.
Bidirectional unbounded whole-execution equivalence retains every Csem evaluation order, trace, final state and error.

external_environment: Only the fixed recognized fabs/fabsf standard intrinsic is reachable; no volatile access, unknown external callback, inline assembly or I/O is added. Invalid raw calls and memories remain represented and may block.
trusted_boundary: Pinned source extraction and CompCert frontend/standard semantics. The prepared source explicitly binds original fabs/fabsf names to recognized standard intrinsics. General original-libm implementation equivalence is not supplied by this contract.
